response.sql: WITH grouped_data AS (SELECT s.arcref, p.fundflux, SUM(s.gbsize) / SUM(s.spanmin) as rate FROM scans s INNER JOIN projects p ON s.arcref = p.arcregistry GROUP BY s.arcref, p.fundflux), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(rate) as avg_rate FROM grouped_data), filtered_data AS (SELECT gd.arcref, gd.fundflux, gd.rate, gd.rate - b.avg_rate as excess FROM grouped_data gd CROSS JOIN benchmark b WHERE gd.rate > b.avg_rate) SELECT arcref, fundflux, rate, excess FROM filtered_data ORDER BY excess DESC LIMIT 10
